title: Implement init.lua - Plugin initialization
description: Create init.lua as the main entry point. Implement setup() function for lazy.nvim configuration. Load and initialize all modules. Set up autocmds and commands.

title: Create CLI script to send stdin to all registry sessions
description:
Create a CLI script that reads from stdin and sends the content to all Neovim sessions listed in the listen registry. The script should:

- Read content from stdin
- Connect to each listen socket in the registry
- Send content to set a vim register in each session
- Accept command line flags:
  - `--register` or `-r`: Specify which vim register to write to (default: clipboard register `"*`)
  - `--env-guard` or `-e`: Environment variable check in format NAME=VALUE. Only run if environment variable exists and matches the specified value. Example: CLIPBOARD_STATE=data
- Handle connection errors gracefully (skip invalid sockets)
- Report which sessions were successfully updated

This enables external tools to sync clipboard content across all Neovim instances via the registry.

Technical details:
- Use netcat or similar to connect to Unix sockets
- Use nvim channel API to set registers remotely
- Handle async communication with all sockets
- Parse CLI flags with proper validation
